source: OSM map API snapshot (lattice tiles of tools/build-perth-west-landuse.ts covering the west extension -3232,-1600 to -1200,1232 m of the Perth frame and 120 m beyond, fetched 2026-11-13); land use, leisure and natural areas, highways (no tunnels or indoor; bridges painted through), natural=tree nodes, natural=cliff ways, viewpoint and peak nodes (outlooks); the trunk block: highway=motorway and trunk ways with their links and roundabouts, drawn as carriageways

trunk.basis: Each way is drawn at its own width: the OSM width tag ('OSM width'); else its lanes tag times 3.65 m plus 1 m hard strips each side, or for a motorway a 3.3 m hard shoulder and a 1 m offside strip, the lane and edge widths ASSUMED ('OSM lanes'); else two lanes (one on a slip road) by the same make-up ('ASSUMED'). No way is drawn under 6 m (a slip road or a one-lane way). Lines are cut to the run within 40 m of the extent.
